name: haven-os
description: A self-hosted home for one person and their AI companion — one Cloudflare Worker, one Supabase project, every personal fact config.

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm ci

VOICE_NOTES.description: R2 bucket for voice-note audio. Never public — served only through the app's session-gated route.

GALLERY.description: R2 bucket for generated images and reference photos. Never public.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Managed in-app (Secrets Store). The setup wizard writes the value — create the secret with the placeholder value UNSET and move on.

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.description: Managed in-app (Secrets Store) — the admin panel sets it when you're ready for voice. Create the secret with the placeholder value UNSET and move on.

GETIMG_API_KEY.description: Managed in-app (Secrets Store) — the admin panel sets it when you're ready for images. Create the secret with the placeholder value UNSET and move on.

HA_MCP_URL.description: Managed in-app (Secrets Store) — the admin panel sets it if you connect Home Assistant. Create the secret with the placeholder value UNSET and move on.

HA_TOKEN.description: Managed in-app (Secrets Store) — the admin panel sets it if you connect Home Assistant. Create the secret with the placeholder value UNSET and move on.

NOTION_TOKEN.description: Managed in-app (Secrets Store) — the admin panel sets it if you connect Notion. Create the secret with the placeholder value UNSET and move on.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Managed in-app (Secrets Store) — powers memory embeddings; the admin panel sets it. Create the secret with the placeholder value UNSET and move on.
